title: wigandia caracasana var. viscosa
intro: Wigandia caracasana var. viscosa, commonly known as "viscous Wigandia" or "sticky Wigandia," is a plant species belonging to the Boraginaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Latin American folk medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Wigandia caracasana var. viscosa include modulating the immune system, reducing oxidative stress, and exhibiting antioxidant and anti-ulcerative activities. Its bioactive constituents include iridoid glycosides, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
